jess: Heads-up 12 Acme needs a short-lived hosted API key for the POC. Requirements: streaming enabled, IP-restricted to 198.51.100.0/24, TTL=8h, audit retention 90d, tag `sales/acme_poc`, add note \"demo-day\". Please DO NOT paste the raw token in shared docs.

mike: I can issue an ephemeral key via Console or CLI and DM it to the SE. Prefer CLI so we can include metadata and TTL in the issuance record. Confirm scopes: generate + stream only?

tara: Confirmed scopes: generate,stream. Label: sales/acme-poc. Metadata: created_by=sales_jess demo_date=2025-03-15. Will add `revocation_owner:sales` for quick revoke.

security: For POCs this is acceptable if audit logging is enabled. Enforce revoke-on-idle = 72h and require we do not store keys in passwordless docs. If customer requests rotation cadence, recommend rotating after each demo session. :lock:

ops-bot: ticket SLS-4922 created: provisioning request queued.

mike: key created id=tok_01HacmExmpl expires=1765436800 (8h). IP allowlist applied. Audit link: https://console.redwood.ai/projects/acme/poc/logs?ticket=SLS-4922

mike: DMing SE with token and expiry now. Example request for SE/test: 
```
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD_ACME_POC_<REDACTED>\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  -d '{"model":"rw-stream-1","input":"Test"}' \\n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
```

jess: Received. I'll provide the token on the demo call only and then rotate immediately afterwards. Please add rotation checklist to SLS-4922 (manual rotate + revoke old token + confirm audit entries).

mike: Done. Rotation checklist attached to SLS-4922 and follow-up reminder set for 9h from now. If the customer extends the POC, open a renewal request and switch to a short-lived automation. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
